text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeat at the Takarazuka Kinen. Having 
exhausted all tactics and still fallen 
short of victory, Seiun Sky feels her own 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her rivals immediately turn their 
sights to the next race after finishing 
left her aching with a sense of her own 
inadequacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Everything's just gotten so boring now." 
Seiun Sky lets the words slip out. Was it 
a moment of weakness, or did she have an 
ulterior motive...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following King Halo's nomination, Seiun 
Sky decides on the Tenno Sho (Autumn) for 
his next race. It marks the beginning of a 
summer filled with lingering anxiety――
